### Observed differences

- A02 became far more frequent and much earlier in the case: it appears in about 65 in 100 traces in the later window (about 15 in 100 before), its mean occurrences per trace rose from about 0.17 to 0.69, and its mean relative position moved from about 0.53 to 0.20 of the case. [OCC001, POS001]
- The handover around A02 changed: in the later window A14 leads to A02 in about 60 in 100 of its observed outgoing transitions (about 1 in 100 before), A14's share leading directly to A15 fell from about 84 to about 37 in 100, and A02 leads to A15 in about 87 in 100 of its outgoing transitions (about 9 in 100 before). [DIR001, DIR004]
- The new adjacency is close: A14 is followed by A02 within one step in about 98 of 100 cases in the later window (before, only 10 observations spread over one to five steps), A02 is followed by A15 within one step in about 48 of 100 (4 observations before), and the A14→A15 distance moved from mostly one step to mostly two. [LAG001, LAG005, LAG006]
- A02 now co-occurs with the downstream activities A15, A20, A22, A23, A25, A29, A30, A40, A45 and A46 in about 65 in 100 traces (about 15 before) and runs before each of them in about 57–60 in 100 traces (about 5–13 before). [REL002, REL004, REL006, REL007, REL009–REL014]
- Two blocks of work swapped order: before, A20, A22 and A23 came before A25 and A29 in about 98 of 100 traces; in the later window A25 and A29 come first in about 97–98 of 100, and A19, A21 and A24 likewise moved from running after these activities to running before them. Positions agree: A19, A21 and A24 now sit earlier (mean relative position about 0.36–0.38 vs about 0.67–0.69), A20, A22 and A23 later (about 0.64–0.65 vs 0.40). [REL015, REL020, REL022, REL024, REL028, REL031, REL034, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007]
- Exits swapped with the blocks: A19, A21 and A24 now lead to A25 in about 97–98 of 100 of their outgoing transitions (previously to A30, about 95 in 100), while A20, A22 and A23 now exit to A30 (about 31–33 in 100) instead of to A25 (about 30–38 in 100); A40 now feeds A19, A21 and A24 (about 40, 29 and 27 in 100) instead of the A20/A22/A23 group. Distances match: A29 reaches A30 in about four steps (previously two), A40 reaches A25 in about two (previously four), and A29 now precedes A22 within one to three steps in nearly all traces (one observation before). [DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, DIR009, DIR010, DIR012, LAG018, LAG019, LAG025]
- A06 and A10 became rare: participation fell from about 22 to 5 in 100 traces (A06) and from about 17 to 6 in 100 (A10); the later A06 outgoing profile rests on only 10 observations. [OCC002, OCC003, DIR002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that A02 now runs as a frequent early step between A14 and A15: in the later window A02 appears in about 65 of 100 traces near the start of the case, receives the handover from A14 (about 60 of 100 of A14's outgoing transitions; A02 immediately follows A14 in about 98 of 100 pair observations) and passes on to A15 (about 87 of 100 of A02's outgoing transitions), whereas before, A14 led to A15 directly in about 84 of 100 of its outgoing transitions and at a one-step distance; A02 also now precedes later activities such as A20, A22, A23, A25 and A30 in about 57–60 of 100 traces, where it previously co-occurred with them in only about 15 of 100. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR004, LAG001, LAG005, LAG006, REL004, REL006, REL009, REL011]

This is supported directly and consistently: occurrence, position, direction, relation and lag items all describe the same shift, the later profile rests on 129 traces containing A02 (30 before), and the screening comparison (87 qualifying items against about 1 expected without change) makes sampling variation implausible as an overall explanation. [OCC001, DIR001, REL004]

Limitation: the evidence shows successions and positions, not the underlying model, so it cannot distinguish a strict placement of A02 into the sequential flow from A02 becoming a frequent early, partly parallel step that usually precedes A15; the A02→A15 link sits at exactly one step's distance in about 48 of 100 pair observations. [LAG001, DIR001]

Other differences: the block reordering described above — the A19/A21/A24 block now running before the A20/A22/A23 loop, with A25 and A30 exchanging their exit roles — is a second, directly evidenced structural difference beyond the A02 hypothesis, and A06 and A10 are now observed in only about 5 and 6 of 100 traces (previously about 22 and 17). [REL022, DIR005, DIR006, DIR010, OCC002, OCC003]
